sources.title: Reload Swiss data sheet RS52 (EN)
sources.note: The data sheet RS52 (EN) calls RS52 single-based and states that its grains are impregnated with nitroglycerin; with nitroglycerin besides nitrocellulose the record stores double base, as for the Vihtavuori N500 powders.

97 training rows of this table (hold-out by cartridge, docs/data/published-loads.md); M3 parameters vivacity, energy fitted by the load-table fit (docs/research/interior-load-table-fit-parameters.md), candidate B; double base prior; the other values of interior are fixed inputs of the fit; start pressure per row from defaultStartPressure in core: 30.0 MPa at a barrel of 300 mm and longer; below by the bullet construction of the printed bullet type: lead 24.3 MPa, plated 30.9 MPa, jacketed 30.8 MPa, monolithic 50.0 MPa. Effective model parameters, not load data.
